description: Defines the class 'ocudu::pdcp_rx_metrics' which manages and reports various metrics related to PDCP receive operations, including counters for SDUs, PDUs, latency, and reordering timeouts.

classes.name: pdcp_rx_metrics
classes.description: A class for collecting and managing PDCP receive metrics, with thread-safe latency tracking and metrics retrieval/reset functionalities.

methods.name: is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if metrics collection is enabled.

methods.name: add_data_pdus
methods.description: Increments data PDU counters if enabled.

methods.name: add_lost_pdus
methods.description: Increments lost PDU counters if enabled.

methods.name: add_dropped_pdus
methods.description: Increments dropped PDU counters if enabled.

methods.name: add_integrity_verified_pdus
methods.description: Increments integrity-verified PDU counters if enabled.

methods.name: add_integrity_failed_pdus
methods.description: Increments integrity-failed PDU counters if enabled.

methods.name: add_t_reordering_timeouts
methods.description: Increments reordering timeout counters if enabled.

methods.name: add_reordering_delay_us
methods.description: Adds reordering delay in microseconds and increments counter if enabled.

methods.name: add_crypto_processing_latency
methods.description: Records crypto processing latency in a thread-safe manner if enabled.

methods.name: add_sdu_latency_ns
methods.description: Records SDU latency, updates histogram, and min/max latency if enabled.

methods.name: get_metrics
methods.description: Returns current metrics snapshot, asserting if disabled.

methods.name: get_metrics_and_reset
methods.description: Returns current metrics and resets counters, asserting if disabled.

methods.name: reset_metrics
methods.description: Resets all metrics counters, preserving the reordering counter, asserting if disabled.
